{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of patients in this group
n_control_moderate = len(control_moderate)

# Check how many responded
n_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_control_moderate

print(f"Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients: {n_control_moderate}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
